Product.title: Product
Product.description: Mobile spare part inventory item stored in Firestore for real-time cross-installation stock and compatibility synchronization.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the shop owner who owns this inventory item.

productName.description: Display title of the spare part product.

screenSize.description: Optional screen size specification such as 6.57".

stockQuantity.description: Current stock quantity on hand (non-negative integer).

boxNumber.description: Physical rack, bin, or box number such as B-023.

universalGroupId.description: Linked universal model group code such as TG-001, or empty string if unlinked.

compatibleModels.description: List of compatible mobile model names sharing this spare part.

notes.description: Optional shop notes or quality remarks.

isPublished.description: True only for globally shared catalog items published by a verified admin; false for user-scoped shop inventory.

UniversalModel.title: UniversalModel
UniversalModel.description: Universal compatibility model group linking multiple mobile models to a single physical spare part, synchronized in real time.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator who owns this universal model group.

updatedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user or verified admin who last updated this group.

groupCode.description: Universal compatibility code such as TG-001 or CC-004.

brand.description: Extracted or normalized mobile brand name.

screenSize.description: Optional screen size specification such as 6.57".

compatibleModels.description: List of compatible mobile model names sharing the same physical spare part.

releaseNote.description: Optional update note describing compatibility changes.

isPublished.description: True when published globally to all installations by a verified admin; false when private to userId installations.

OfficialUniversalGroup.title: OfficialUniversalGroup
OfficialUniversalGroup.description: Official spare parts universal compatibility group published by the shop admin and synced to all app users.

groupCode.description: Human-readable universal compatibility code such as TG-001 or CR-001.

brand.description: Extracted or normalized mobile brand name.

screenSize.description: Optional screen size string such as 6.57".

compatibleModels.description: List of compatible mobile model names sharing the same physical part.

releaseNote.description: Optional official update note shown to users.

isPublished.description: Whether this official compatibility group is published globally.

updatedByUid.description: UID of the verified admin who published or last updated this document.

AdminMarker.title: AdminMarker
AdminMarker.description: Optional admin allowlist marker document keyed by admin UID.

/products/{productId}.description: Real-time synchronized spare part inventory products scoped per authenticated user across installations, plus verified admin global catalog items.

/universal_models/{modelId}.description: Real-time synchronized universal compatibility model groups supporting user-scoped sync across installations and verified admin global broadcasts.

/official_universal_groups/{groupId}.description: Global official universal spare parts compatibility groups readable by all signed-in users and writable strictly by verified admins.
